about: Where an answer's widgets stand (ADR 0114): the agent writes a place line, {{widget N}}, where widget N belongs; it is taken out of the words and the widget stands before that line of what is left. `places` are the widgets' place numbers (null for one from before place lines); `lines` the line each stands before (null: at the end). Read by crates/loomwatch-backend/src/widgets/mod.rs (when the answer is kept) and ui/src/lib/widgets/place.ts (while it is written), which must agree on every case.
